transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... I just keep beating myself up lately. I've been feeling like I'm not really senior material at my job, and that I basically just fooled everyone into thinking I could handle a lot more than I actually can. It's just been really weighing on me.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things the way you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once found pleasurable?

Yeah, I have noticed that. Normally I really look forward to grilling on the weekend, or maybe going fishing, or even just putting on a record to unwind. But lately... I don't know, I just leave all the stuff sitting there. I just don't really care to do any of it right now.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or that you’re letting people down lately?

Yeah, that's exactly what I meant when we first started talking. Like I said, I just keep beating myself up over work. I feel like I'm letting everyone down because I'm not really senior material. I just feel like I somehow fooled them all into thinking I could handle this level of responsibility, and... yeah, I definitely feel like I'm not good enough right now.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?

Yeah, I have. Most days lately, I just have this... this heavy, low feeling all day long. It's like I'm just going through the motions at work and at home, but everything just feels dull, you know? Like the color is just turned down on everything.
Have you noticed that you're feeling more tired or that you're lacking energy lately, even when you haven't been doing much?

Yeah, definitely. It's like... by the time I get home from the office, I just don't have any energy left. Even simple things, like checking the mail or just loading the dishwasher, they just feel like way more effort than they should right now.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Yeah, my appetite has definitely been off. I haven't really been eating full meals... mostly just grabbing a few bites of something here and there, or just skipping supper altogether. And I've noticed my belt is a little looser lately, even though I'm definitely not trying to lose any weight.
Have you been having thoughts that life isn’t worth living or considered harming yourself?
I haven't made any actual plans to hurt myself or anything like that, no. But... I do catch myself thinking sometimes that it might just be easier if I didn't wake up some morning.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I'd say... it's been about a month. The noticeable up-and-down pattern really started around then, right after they asked me to cover the senior analyst duties at work.
Have you ever felt this way before, like you were stuck in a low mood or struggling with similar thoughts about yourself?
Yeah, I have. When I really look back at it... these low, guilty periods have actually been hanging around off and on for about eleven months now.
Have there been times when you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or so confident that you didn’t sleep much but still felt rested?

Yeah, actually. Right before this low stretch started, I had... I don't know, maybe a few days where I felt almost too sure of myself. Like I was totally on top of everything. But I was also getting really irritable. I'd just snap at people over really small stuff—like if an email took too long to load, or if a client asked the same question twice. It was just... I had zero patience for it.
How long did your previous low mood periods typically last, and did they ever completely go away before this most recent one started?

I'm not exactly sure, to be honest. I didn't really track the days. It's hard to say exactly how long they lasted... or if they ever completely went away before this recent one started. Maybe they did clear up for a bit, or maybe the feeling just faded enough that I didn't notice it as much. I just don't have a very clear timeline in my head for those older ones.
Did you feel any significant improvement in your mood or functioning between these low periods, or did you generally feel down throughout the past eleven months?

I'm really not sure. Like I said, it's hard to remember exactly how I felt between those times. I just didn't keep track of it, so I can't really say if things improved or if I was just kind of down the whole time.
